# Lavendar Lewis & Stephen Irving

- [Lavendar Lewis](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) — Romantically involved with — [Stephen Irving](../character/stephen-irving.md) — formerly engaged twenty-five years ago · since v2  <sub>[v2 I An Irate Neighbor P45](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0045), [v2 XXII Odds and Ends P9](../source/v02-c22.md#nw-v02-c22-p0009), [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P22](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0022)</sub>
- [Lavendar Lewis](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) — Spouse of — [Stephen Irving](../character/stephen-irving.md) — married wife · since v2  <sub>[v2 XXX A Wedding at the Stone House P30](../source/v02-c30.md#nw-v02-c30-p0030)</sub>

## Shared scenes

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) visits [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge) and helps Miss Lavendar make a new dress before visiting [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md) in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea). There, she meets Paul's father, [Stephen Irving](../character/stephen-irving.md), who asks her to carry a message to Miss Lavendar about visiting her. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) delivers the note and helps an excited Miss Lavendar prepare for Stephen's arrival.
>
> — v2 · XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace

_Sources: [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P17](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0017), [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P21](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0021), [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P35](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0035), [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P57](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0057)_

> [Stephen Irving](../character/stephen-irving.md) arrives at [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge) to visit Miss Lavendar. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) greets him on the porch and ushers him into the parlor to meet Miss Lavendar. Later, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Charlotta](../character/charlotta.md) spot Stephen and Miss Lavendar walking together affectionately in the garden, confirming their joyful reconciliation.
>
> — v2 · XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace

_Sources: [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P59](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0059), [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P64](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0064), [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P70](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0070), [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P71](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0071)_

> Miss Lavendar and [Stephen Irving](../character/stephen-irving.md) are married at [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge) in a lovely ceremony attended by their friends. After seeing the newlyweds off, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) finish tidying the house, where a brief romantic spark between them hints at the changing chapter of Anne's life.
>
> — v2 · XXX A Wedding at the Stone House

_Sources: [v2 XXX A Wedding at the Stone House P29](../source/v02-c30.md#nw-v02-c30-p0029), [v2 XXX A Wedding at the Stone House P30](../source/v02-c30.md#nw-v02-c30-p0030), [v2 XXX A Wedding at the Stone House P33](../source/v02-c30.md#nw-v02-c30-p0033), [v2 XXX A Wedding at the Stone House P40](../source/v02-c30.md#nw-v02-c30-p0040)_
